run.final_text:
Steps 1–9 of WF3 are done for D-001: draft schedule **WS-R001** is recorded with 30 determinations under case K-R001, and I have stopped at step 10 for your review and sign-off.

# Hand-over note: D-001, Atlas Growth Fund I LP (AGF1)

Record date is 2026-10-30 and payment date is 2026-11-16. Validity of every clearance and certification was tested on the payment date.

## Totals (USD)

| Component | Gross | Tax withheld | Net |
|---|---|---|---|
| D-001-A, US-source dividend | 10,000,000.00 | 1,510,562.50 | 8,489,437.50 |
| D-001-B, return of capital | 2,000,000.00 | 0.00 | 2,000,000.00 |
| **Total** | **12,000,000.00** | **1,510,562.50** | **10,489,437.50** |

- **Paying company:** the dividend in D-001-A was paid by Orion Manufacturing Inc (E-003) through Atlas Acquisition SPV LLC (P-007, P-008), so the holding threshold was tested against Orion.
- **Rules in force (US, version 2026.1):** R-01 statutory and default 30%; R-02 Luxembourg treaty 15%; R-03 Luxembourg qualifying holding 5% at 10% or more of the votes, inclusive.
- **Default-rate lines:** 307,500 of the tax withheld sits on the three default-rate lines below.

## Lines not cleared (all on D-001-A)

| Recipient | Gross | Outcome | Why | What would cure it |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| I-006 Meridian Holdings I S.à r.l. | 300,000 | Default rate 30%, tax 90,000 | Its treaty claim (F-006) rests on ownership. Clearance CL-006 has open change case K-006. Since 2026-08-01 it and Meridian Holdings II (I-018) each hold 30% of the other (DOC-0106), so ultimate owners cannot be read. R-02 is assessed undetermined (A-R008, finding MF-R001). | A person resolves the circular holding and closes K-006 with a re-decided clearance. |
| I-014 Client account 7731, behind Sterling Nominees (I-007), 37.5% | 225,000 | Default rate 30%, tax 67,500 | No certification and no recorded tax residence (A-R016, findings MF-R002 and MF-R003; existing open item MF-001 on CL-007). | The nominee supplies the owner's certification. |
| I-015 Bertrange Capital S.A. | 500,000 | Default rate 30%, tax 150,000 | Form F-015 ended 2025-12-31 and clearance CL-015W is withdrawn (A-R017, finding MF-R004; existing MF-002). | A new form and a new clearance before the payment date. |
| I-016 Atlas Co-Invest Vehicle LP | 300,000 | Not applicable, paid gross | Certified US person on W-9 F-016. | None needed. |
| I-017 Atlas GP LLC | 401,250 | Not applicable, paid gross | Certified US person on W-9 F-017. | None needed. |

All 15 lines of D-001-B are `notApplicable` at rate 0, because a return of capital is outside every rule in force.

**Default rate rather than hold:** I could not read the fund's terms. No computation returns the governing agreement of a commitment, so nothing is held. If the partnership agreement allows a hold on I-006, I-014 or I-015, that is your call.

## Cleared lines to look at

- **I-003 Kirchberg Industries, 5% (R-03):** its effective voting holding in Orion is exactly 10.0%, which meets the inclusive threshold.
- **I-004 Limpertsberg Holdings, 15%:** its effective voting holding is 9.99%, just under the threshold; I did not round it up.
- **I-005 Grund Participations, 15%:** its economic holding is 10.4% but its voting holding is 8.0%, and the threshold is tested on votes.
- **I-010 Ardennes Industrial Holding, 15%:** it holds 9.6% through the feeder; the feeder's own 24% is not its holding.
- **I-012 Claire Dumont (French resident) and I-009 Alpha Holdings SA (Swiss resident):** both are `cleared` at the statutory 30% as a documented rate. Each has a valid form with no treaty claim, and no treaty rule is in force for their residence.
- **I-013 Echternach Pension Fund, 15%:** it relies on CL-007, which is "admitted with open items". The open item concerns only the other owner, I-014.
- **Remaining lines:** I-001, I-008 and I-011 are cleared at 15% under R-02 with nothing unusual.

## Disagreements and unknowns

- **I-016 holding:** the investor register (C-016, system of record) holds 3.0%; entity management (H-006) holds 3.5%. I used the register; the treasury line of 300,000 matches 3.0%. The rate is unaffected.
- **Two investors named "Alpha Holdings SA":** I-008 is the Luxembourg one (B 214 577) and I-009 the Swiss one (CHE-318.442.907). They were matched on LEI and treated separately.
- **F-015 status flag:** the onboarding system still shows it as VALIDATED although it ended on 2025-12-31. I tested validity on the dates.
- **"US person":** this is not a term in the ontology. I-016 and I-017 were treated as US persons on their W-9 forms and recorded US residence only.
- **Look-through depth:** Atlas Lux Feeder (I-002) and Sterling Nominees (I-007) have no lines of their own; their shares go to the recipients behind them. No recipient is itself an intermediary.
- **Rule text:** the bundle notes that the rule versions are illustrative and have not been checked against the primary text.

steps.executed:
WITH dist AS (
    SELECT d.record_dt, d.pay_dt, f.fund_code
    FROM treasury.distribution d
    JOIN treasury.counterparty cp ON cp.cp_id = d.fund_cp
    JOIN investor_register.fund f ON f.lei = cp.lei
    WHERE d.dist_id = %(distribution_id)s
), intermediary AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT t.inv_no
    FROM onboarding.tax_form t, dist
    WHERE t.is_intermediary = 'Y' AND t.form_status <> 'SUPERSEDED'
      AND t.signed_dt <= dist.pay_dt AND (t.valid_to IS NULL OR t.valid_to >= dist.pay_dt)
), payee AS (
    SELECT c.inv_no, c.commit_id, i.lei, c.inv_no IN (SELECT inv_no FROM intermediary) AS looked_through
    FROM dist
    JOIN investor_register.commitment c ON c.fund_code = dist.fund_code
         AND c.from_dt <= dist.record_dt AND (c.to_dt IS NULL OR c.to_dt >= dist.record_dt)
    JOIN investor_register.investor i ON i.inv_no = c.inv_no
), recipient AS (
    SELECT p.inv_no AS investor_no, p.inv_no AS recipient_no, 100::numeric AS share_pct, 'own account' AS basis,
           'investor_register.commitment:' || p.commit_id AS source_ref
    FROM payee p WHERE NOT p.looked_through
    UNION ALL
    SELECT p.inv_no, c.inv_no, c.unit_pct, 'investor in a flow-through fund vehicle',
           'investor_register.commitment:' || c.commit_id
    FROM payee p
    JOIN investor_register.fund f ON f.lei = p.lei
    JOIN investor_register.commitment c ON c.fund_code = f.fund_code
    CROSS JOIN dist
    WHERE p.looked_through AND c.from_dt <= dist.record_dt AND (c.to_dt IS NULL OR c.to_dt >= dist.record_dt)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT p.inv_no, o.owner_inv_no, o.pct_econ, 'beneficial owner behind a nominee',
           'onboarding.declared_owner:' || o.decl_id
    FROM payee p
    JOIN onboarding.declared_owner o ON o.owned_inv_no = p.inv_no AND o.alloc_basis = 'NOMINEE_ALLOC'
    CROSS JOIN dist
    WHERE p.looked_through AND o.from_dt <= dist.record_dt AND (o.to_dt IS NULL OR o.to_dt >= dist.record_dt)
)
SELECT r.investor_no, r.recipient_no, i.display_name AS recipient_name, r.share_pct, r.basis,
       r.recipient_no IN (SELECT inv_no FROM intermediary) AS recipient_is_intermediary, r.source_ref
FROM recipient r JOIN investor_register.investor i ON i.inv_no = r.recipient_no
ORDER BY r.investor_no, r.recipient_no

WITH latest AS (
    SELECT c.*, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY c.clearance_of ORDER BY c.decided_on DESC, c.valid_from DESC) AS position
    FROM clearance.clearance c
    WHERE c.in_context_of = %(fund_code)s AND c.decided_on <= %(on_date)s::date AND c.valid_from <= %(on_date)s::date
)
SELECT l.clearance_id AS clearance, l.clearance_of AS party_no, l.clearance_status, l.decided_on, l.valid_from, l.valid_to,
       (l.clearance_status IN ('cleared', 'admittedWithOpenItems')
        AND (l.valid_to IS NULL OR l.valid_to >= %(on_date)s::date)) AS in_force_on_date,
       l.default_treatment,
       (SELECT array_agg(m.finding_id || ' (' || m.unmet_requirement || '): ' || m.description ORDER BY m.finding_id)
        FROM clearance.missing_fact_finding m WHERE m.clearance_id = l.clearance_id) AS open_items,
       (SELECT array_agg(k.case_id || ': ' || e.description ORDER BY k.case_id)
        FROM clearance.case k LEFT JOIN clearance.change_event e ON e.change_id = k.triggered_by
        WHERE k.concerns_party = l.clearance_of AND k.case_kind = 'change'
          AND k.opened_on <= %(on_date)s::date AND (k.closed_on IS NULL OR k.closed_on > %(on_date)s::date)) AS open_change_cases,
       (SELECT array_agg(r.source_ref ORDER BY r.source_ref) FROM clearance.clearance_reliance r
        WHERE r.clearance_id = l.clearance_id) AS relies_on,
       'clearance.clearance:' || l.clearance_id AS source_ref
FROM latest l
WHERE l.position = 1
ORDER BY l.clearance_of

RETURN h.id AS holder, h.name AS name, h.sourceRefs AS source_refs,
       round(sum(economic), 4) AS effective_economic_pct, round(sum(voting), 4) AS effective_voting_pct

parameters.reasoning: D-001-A is a US-source dividend (paid by Orion Manufacturing Inc, E-003, via Atlas Acquisition SPV). Harbor Pension Trust receives on own account. FR-04: tax residence LU on payment date 2026-11-16. FR-05: W-8BEN-E F-001 valid on payment date, claims LU treaty, limitation-on-benefits PENSION (not ownership-based, so FR-07 not engaged). Clearance CL-001 in force on payment date with no open items or change case. Effective voting holding in Orion is 8.0%, below the R-03 threshold of 10%, so the 15% treaty rate of R-02 applies, not 5%.

FR-06: effective voting percentage of Harbor Pension Trust in the paying company Orion Manufacturing Inc (E-003) on 2026-11-16 is 8.0% (10% of the fund x 80% through the chain), below the inclusive 10% threshold. The qualifying-holding rate does not apply.

D-001-A is a US-source dividend paid by Orion Manufacturing Inc (E-003). Kirchberg Industries S.A. receives on own account. R-02 facts met: tax residence LU on payment date 2026-11-16 (FR-04); W-8BEN-E F-003 valid on payment date, claims LU treaty with limitation-on-benefits ACTIVE_TRADE (FR-05; not ownership-based so FR-07 not engaged). FR-06: effective voting percentage in Orion is 10.0% (12.5% voting in the fund through the chain), which equals the 10% threshold; the threshold is inclusive, so it is met. Clearance CL-003 in force on payment date, no open items or change case. Rate 5%.

US-source dividend paid by Orion Manufacturing Inc (E-003). Limpertsberg Holdings S.A. receives on own account. FR-04: tax residence LU on payment date 2026-11-16. FR-05: W-8BEN-E F-004 valid on payment date, claims LU treaty, limitation-on-benefits ACTIVE_TRADE (FR-07 not engaged). Clearance CL-004 in force, no open items or change case. Effective voting holding in Orion is 9.99%, below the 10% threshold of R-03, so the 15% rate of R-02 applies.

FR-06: effective voting percentage of Limpertsberg Holdings S.A. in the paying company Orion Manufacturing Inc (E-003) on 2026-11-16 is 9.99% (12.4875% voting in the fund through the chain), below the inclusive 10% threshold. Not rounded up. The qualifying-holding rate does not apply.

US-source dividend paid by Orion Manufacturing Inc (E-003). Grund Participations S.A. receives on own account. FR-04: tax residence LU on payment date 2026-11-16. FR-05: W-8BEN-E F-005 valid on payment date, claims LU treaty, limitation-on-benefits ACTIVE_TRADE (FR-07 not engaged). Clearance CL-005 in force, no open items or change case. Effective voting holding in Orion is 8.0% (economic 10.4%); the R-03 threshold is tested on voting, so R-03 does not apply and the 15% rate of R-02 applies.

FR-06: effective voting percentage of Grund Participations S.A. in Orion Manufacturing Inc (E-003) on 2026-11-16 is 8.0% (10% voting in the fund through the chain). Its effective economic percentage is 10.4% (13% economic), but the threshold is tested on voting percentage, not economic. Below the inclusive 10% threshold; the qualifying-holding rate does not apply.

parameters.reasoning: Meridian Holdings I S.à r.l. is LU resident on the payment date and W-8BEN-E F-006 is valid and claims the LU treaty, but its limitation-on-benefits category is OWNERSHIP_BASE_EROSION, so the claim rests on who owns it (FR-07). Clearance CL-006 relied on declaration DO-003; change case K-006 is open (restructuring effective 2026-08-01, DOC-0106), so the clearance is not relied on for a reduced rate. Current declarations DO-004 to DO-007 show Meridian Holdings I and Meridian Holdings II (I-018) each holding 30% of the other, with Meridian Family Trust (Jersey) holding 70% of each; ownership-cycles reports the I-006/I-018 circular holding. result.text:
Steps 1–9 of WF3 are done for D-001: draft schedule **WS-R001** is recorded with 30 determinations under case K-R001, and I have stopped at step 10 for your review and sign-off.

# Hand-over note: D-001, Atlas Growth Fund I LP (AGF1)

Record date is 2026-10-30 and payment date is 2026-11-16. Validity of every clearance and certification was tested on the payment date.

## Totals (USD)

| Component | Gross | Tax withheld | Net |
|---|---|---|---|
| D-001-A, US-source dividend | 10,000,000.00 | 1,510,562.50 | 8,489,437.50 |
| D-001-B, return of capital | 2,000,000.00 | 0.00 | 2,000,000.00 |
| **Total** | **12,000,000.00** | **1,510,562.50** | **10,489,437.50** |

- **Paying company:** the dividend in D-001-A was paid by Orion Manufacturing Inc (E-003) through Atlas Acquisition SPV LLC (P-007, P-008), so the holding threshold was tested against Orion.
- **Rules in force (US, version 2026.1):** R-01 statutory and default 30%; R-02 Luxembourg treaty 15%; R-03 Luxembourg qualifying holding 5% at 10% or more of the votes, inclusive.
- **Default-rate lines:** 307,500 of the tax withheld sits on the three default-rate lines below.

## Lines not cleared (all on D-001-A)

| Recipient | Gross | Outcome | Why | What would cure it |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| I-006 Meridian Holdings I S.à r.l. | 300,000 | Default rate 30%, tax 90,000 | Its treaty claim (F-006) rests on ownership. Clearance CL-006 has open change case K-006. Since 2026-08-01 it and Meridian Holdings II (I-018) each hold 30% of the other (DOC-0106), so ultimate owners cannot be read. R-02 is assessed undetermined (A-R008, finding MF-R001). | A person resolves the circular holding and closes K-006 with a re-decided clearance. |
| I-014 Client account 7731, behind Sterling Nominees (I-007), 37.5% | 225,000 | Default rate 30%, tax 67,500 | No certification and no recorded tax residence (A-R016, findings MF-R002 and MF-R003; existing open item MF-001 on CL-007). | The nominee supplies the owner's certification. |
| I-015 Bertrange Capital S.A. | 500,000 | Default rate 30%, tax 150,000 | Form F-015 ended 2025-12-31 and clearance CL-015W is withdrawn (A-R017, finding MF-R004; existing MF-002). | A new form and a new clearance before the payment date. |
| I-016 Atlas Co-Invest Vehicle LP | 300,000 | Not applicable, paid gross | Certified US person on W-9 F-016. | None needed. |
| I-017 Atlas GP LLC | 401,250 | Not applicable, paid gross | Certified US person on W-9 F-017. | None needed. |

All 15 lines of D-001-B are `notApplicable` at rate 0, because a return of capital is outside every rule in force.

**Default rate rather than hold:** I could not read the fund's terms. No computation returns the governing agreement of a commitment, so nothing is held. If the partnership agreement allows a hold on I-006, I-014 or I-015, that is your call.

## Cleared lines to look at

- **I-003 Kirchberg Industries, 5% (R-03):** its effective voting holding in Orion is exactly 10.0%, which meets the inclusive threshold.
- **I-004 Limpertsberg Holdings, 15%:** its effective voting holding is 9.99%, just under the threshold; I did not round it up.
- **I-005 Grund Participations, 15%:** its economic holding is 10.4% but its voting holding is 8.0%, and the threshold is tested on votes.
- **I-010 Ardennes Industrial Holding, 15%:** it holds 9.6% through the feeder; the feeder's own 24% is not its holding.
- **I-012 Claire Dumont (French resident) and I-009 Alpha Holdings SA (Swiss resident):** both are `cleared` at the statutory 30% as a documented rate. Each has a valid form with no treaty claim, and no treaty rule is in force for their residence.
- **I-013 Echternach Pension Fund, 15%:** it relies on CL-007, which is "admitted with open items". The open item concerns only the other owner, I-014.
- **Remaining lines:** I-001, I-008 and I-011 are cleared at 15% under R-02 with nothing unusual.

## Disagreements and unknowns

- **I-016 holding:** the investor register (C-016, system of record) holds 3.0%; entity management (H-006) holds 3.5%. I used the register; the treasury line of 300,000 matches 3.0%. The rate is unaffected.
- **Two investors named "Alpha Holdings SA":** I-008 is the Luxembourg one (B 214 577) and I-009 the Swiss one (CHE-318.442.907). They were matched on LEI and treated separately.
- **F-015 status flag:** the onboarding system still shows it as VALIDATED although it ended on 2025-12-31. I tested validity on the dates.
- **"US person":** this is not a term in the ontology. I-016 and I-017 were treated as US persons on their W-9 forms and recorded US residence only.
- **Look-through depth:** Atlas Lux Feeder (I-002) and Sterling Nominees (I-007) have no lines of their own; their shares go to the recipients behind them. No recipient is itself an intermediary.
- **Rule text:** the bundle notes that the rule versions are illustrative and have not been checked against the primary text.
